revision: B2 (home v2: the held stage carries the h1, the action and pictures only)
idea: On this page, the hi-vis vest every Bellis crew wears becomes the poster's ground: flat safety-yellow and black, blunt statements at full volume, product cut-outs stuck on at a tilt.
storyline: The one line that says what this is, held still; then the five jobs, stuck on the crew's photograph one at a time
rhythm: HOLD: the h1 and the action stand at p 0 and never move; the crew photograph rises and five stickers land on its collage, one per job, in order; REST. The five statements follow the stage as poster fields, not held

chapters.label: Opening statement
chapters.concept: The h1 and the action are readable at p 0 and do not move. As the visitor scrolls the held stage, the crew photograph rises a little and settles its tilt, and five stickers land on its collage one after another, one for each job the statements name; then the stage rests. The stage carries four words of text.

verbs.title: HOLDS
verbs.stickers: FIRST ONE IS THERE AT P0; THE REST LAND ONE PER JOB

transitionOut.cause: the statement block that follows opens on an ink field, so the yellow stage ends at a hard colour edge

chapters.stickerNote: the first sticker (Rockwool, temperature) is on the collage at p = 0 (from = to = 0: placed, never moving); the other four arrive one per job
